title: Global AI Ethics: A Review of the Social Impacts and Ethical Implications of Artificial Intelligence
reasoning: The paper is a comprehensive literature review of AI ethics that explicitly evaluates and defines ethics through a plurality of global frameworks. It includes a dedicated section discussing Western moral philosophies (Kantianism, deontology, etc.) alongside major religious and spiritual traditions, including Confucian, Shinto, Hindu, Judaism, Christianity, and Islam, to argue that ethical systems are inseparable from cultural and religious contexts.
